## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The revision mismatch should be fixed so running deployments display the same identifier as history and completion output.

## Changes
Adds a running-deployment status formatter with an attempt label and tests for the status framing and attempt text.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/display.py:14 — correctness — Match the revision length used by history — For revision `0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567`, `status` displays `0123456` instead of `0123456789ab`. Its docstring promises “the same identifier as history,” but the new slice takes seven characters while `history` takes twelve. — Users viewing full revisions receive inconsistent deployment identifiers across running, history, and completion output. — Fix: Use `revision[:12]` and extend `test_running_status_contains_attempt` to check the complete status string.
